EN:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}The best way to learn about art is
to see it in person.
ES:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}La mejor manera para aprender
sobre arte es venir al museo y
ver las obras con tus propios ojos.
FR:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}L'art, c'est d'abord une rencontre
entre l'œuvre et soi...
IT:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Il modo migliore per studiare
le opere d'arte è vederle di persona!
DE:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Am besten lernt man etwas über
Kunst, indem man sie sich selbst
anschaut.
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Sanatı öğrenmenin en iyi yolu onu kendi
gözlerinle görmek.

EN:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}I like to know what the artist was
thinking about when he or she
created each piece{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.
{{TAG:0003:001A:}}I'm kind of nosy like that.{{TAG:0007:0000:1E000000}}{{TAG:0003:0025:}}
ES:
{{TAG:0003:000B:}}Me gustaría saber en qué piensa
un artista cuando crea una obra{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.
FR:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Souvent, j'essaie d'imaginer l'artiste
au travail, de me le représenter
soudain assailli par l'inspiration{{TAG:0007:0000:05000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:05000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:05000000}}.{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:001A:}}Oui, je suis curieuse... J'aime bien
savoir où, comment, pourquoi et
quand les choses se passent, hi hi !{{TAG:0007:0000:1E000000}}{{TAG:0003:0025:}}
IT:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Io adoooro immaginare a cosa
pensasse l'artista mentre creava
le sue opere{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.
{{TAG:0003:001A:}}Ebbene sì, sono una gran curiosona!{{TAG:0007:0000:1E000000}}{{TAG:0003:0025:}}

EN:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Looking at art is great,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} but it's also
nice just spending time in a quiet,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}
warm space like this.
It's so relaxing,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} {{TAG:0005:0007:}}.
FR:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}La nourriture spirituelle, c'est bien,
{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}}mais poser un peu son popotin cinq
minutes, ça ne fait pas de mal.{{TAG:0000:0004:}}Surtout dans un endroit si apaisant,
{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}}c'est tellement agréable.
{{TAG:0007:0000:0F000000}}{{TAG:000E:0003:}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}.
IT:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Guardare le opere d'arte è sublime,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}
ma io adoooro anche solo stare
{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}in una sala silenziosa come questa.
È così {{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}}rilassante,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} {{TAG:0005:0007:}}.
DE:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Ich schaue mir gerne die Kunstwerke
an, aber ich genieße es auch, dass
die Räume so warm und ruhig sind.
Diese Stille.{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}} Richtig entspannend,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}
{{TAG:0005:0007:}}!

EN:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}I never get bored,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} no matter how
many times I come here.{{TAG:0007:0001:}} {{TAG:0003:0005:}}In fact,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} it
seems like there's always new stuff!
ES:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Por muchas veces que venga,
{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}}jamás me aburro. {{TAG:0007:0001:}}{{TAG:0003:0005:}}¡Y parece que
todos los días hay cositas nuevas!
FR:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Je pourrais venir ici 365 jours par
an sans m'ennuyer ! {{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}}Vraiment, l'art
fait passer la lassitude à l'as !{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0005:}}Et j'ai l'impression de découvrir de
nouvelles choses à chaque visite !
DE:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Egal wie oft ich herkomme, ich
langweile mich nie.{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}} {{TAG:0003:0005:}}Es gibt immer
etwas Neues zu entdecken.
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Kaç kez gelirsem geleyim,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} hiç sıkılmıyorum.{{TAG:0007:0001:}}
{{TAG:0003:0005:}}Hatta,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} sanki her seferinde yeni bir şey var!

EN:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}When you examine a work of art,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}
it's important to consider the
period in which it was created.
{{TAG:0003:0000:}}It can help you figure out what
the artist{{TAG:0003:0001:}} was trying to say.
ES:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Para entender una obra de arte,
{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}}es importante tener en cuenta
la época en la que se creó.
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Así, {{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}}es más fácil comprender qué
quería expresar el artista.
FR:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Il ne faut jamais oublier de prendre
en compte l'époque de création
quand on est confronté à une œuvre.{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0000:}}Ça peut se révéler très utile pour
saisir les intentions de l'artiste {{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}}{{TAG:0003:0001:}}si
elles semblent un tantinet obscures.
IT:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Quando guardi un'opera d'arte,
{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}è importante tenere a mente
il periodo in cui è stata realizzata.
{{TAG:0003:0000:}}Può aiutarti a capire quello che
l'artista{{TAG:0003:0001:}} voleva esprimere.
DE:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Wenn man sich ein Kunstwerk
ansieht, sollte man immer bedenken,
aus welcher Zeit es stammt.
{{TAG:0003:0000:}}So kann man viel leichter sagen,
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}was damit ausgedrückt werden
sollte.
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Bir sanat eserini incelerken,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} yapıldığı
dönemi hesaba katmak önemlidir.
{{TAG:0003:0000:}}Böylece sanatçının{{TAG:0003:0001:}} ne anlatmaya
çalıştığını daha iyi anlayabilirsin.
